candidates.name: Bull Run II Pipeline
candidates.from: new Delaware Basin processing plants (Wrangler, Ranger, Ranger II)

evidence.note: Targa plans a 70-mile residue gas pipeline added to its Bull Run system to Waha, supported by take-or-pay commitments, in service first half of 2028. Diameter not stated.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Roster has P7854 Bull Run Extension (43 km, 42 in, construction) and P7852 Bull Run; Bull Run II is a separate later 70-mile (about 113 km) project, but could be matched to P7854 by the consolidator. Diameter unknown.

candidates.name: Permian Link Project
candidates.sponsor: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America (Kinder Morgan)
candidates.from: NGPL Permian Zone near Pecos County, Texas
candidates.to: NGPL Midcontinent Zone, Texas Panhandle (options east to Beckham County, Oklahoma)

evidence.note: Non-binding solicitation: new greenfield 42-inch pipeline plus compression, 2.1 Bcf/d north and 0.5 Bcf/d south, target in service July 2030. Length not stated.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for a Pecos County to Midcontinent greenfield NGPL line (P0222 is the existing NGPL system). Length unknown but greenfield trunk across West Texas to the Panhandle is certainly over 25 km. Interstate (FERC) but starts in this slice.

candidates.name: West Texas Express Pipeline
candidates.to: El Paso area, Texas (laterals to Hudspeth County and US-Mexico border)

evidence.note: Non-binding open season Sept 8-25, 2026: 2 Bcf/d, more than 150 miles of new 42-inch pipe, target in service Q4 2029.
Enbridge open season notice for West Texas Express.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster. Overlaps in corridor with P2519 Comanche Trail (Waha-San Elizario, operating) and P7840 Desert Southwest, but is a distinct proposal. Also reported by the crossborder agent, consolidator should dedupe.
